('''RCF''') is an Indian [[Public Sector Undertakings in India|central public sector undertaking]] which produces chemical and fertilizers and is based in [[Mumbai]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.rcfltd.com/|title=Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited|website=www.rcfltd.com}}{{Cite web|title=Rashtriya Chemicals And Fertilizers Pays Rs 167.16 Crore Dividend To Govt|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/rashtriya-chemicals-and-fertilizers-pays-rs-167-16-crore-dividend-to-govt-6535351.html|access-date=2021-03-17|website=Moneycontrol|date=17 February 2021 }} It is under the ownership of the [[Government of India]] and administrative control of the [[Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers]]. RCF is fourth largest government owned-fertilizer-producer in India.{{cite web |title=Annual report for 2017–2018 |url=http://www.rcfltd.com/index.php/en/investor-relations/annual-reports/9101-annual-report-for-2017-18 |website=RCF Official website |publisher=RCF}} ==History== Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited, was established in 1978 consequent to the reorganisation of [[Fertilizer Corporation of India]]. RCF manufactures Urea and Complex fertilizers (NPK) along with a wide range of Industrial Chemicals. It is 4th largest Urea manufacturer in India after [[Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative|IFFCO]], [[National Fertilizers|NFL]] and [[Krishak Bharati Cooperative|KRIBHCO]].{{cite news | title = Rashtriya Chemicals & Fertilizers Limited | url = https://dipam.gov.in/sites/default/files/Rashtriya%20Chemicals%20%26%20Fertilizers%20Ltd.%20Investor%20Presentation2016.pdf?download=1 | work = DIPAM Gov | access-date = 8 January 2020 }} The [[Government of India]] (through the [[President of India]]) holds 75% of the share capital of the company as of December 2018.{{cite web |title=Shareholding pattern 31 Dec 2018 |url=http://www.rcfltd.com/index.php/en/investor-relations/shareholding-pattern/10506-shareholding-pattern-as-on-31122018 |website=Official website |publisher=RCF |access-date=7 March 2019}}{{Cite news|date=2021-02-25|title=Volumes spurt at Rashtriya Chemicals & Fertilizers Ltd counter|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/volumes-spurt-at-rashtriya-chemicals-fertilizers-ltd-counter-121022500728_1.html|access-date=2021-03-17}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.rcfltd.com/ Official website] {{Public Sector Undertakings in India}} {{Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers (India)}} {{authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers}} [[Category:Government-owned companies of India]] [[Category:Fertiliser companies of India]] [[Category:Chemical companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1978]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1978]] [[Category:1978 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Government-owned chemical companies of India]]
extract: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Ltd. (RCF) is an Indian central public sector undertaking which produces chemical and fertilizers and is based in Mumbai. It is under the ownership of the Government of India and administrative control of the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers. RCF is fourth largest government owned-fertilizer-producer in India.
